Probability of a red face card, Class 10 Maths board exam: one card drawn from a deck of 52.

• Face cards are J, Q, K in each of the 4 suits: 4 × 3 = 12 (the ace is not a face card)
• Red suits are hearts and diamonds: 2 × 3 = 6 red face cards
• P(E) = favourable / total = 6/52
• Divide top and bottom by 2: P = 3/26
